messages:
elaine_cs: Heads up — RidgeView onboarding shows steady throughput but p99 on the chat endpoint crept up ~70ms after the April model swap. Renewal check-in in two weeks; want a short list of low-risk perf levers to propose.

mike_eng: @elaine_cs can you confirm traffic mix? percent of <512 tokens vs long analytic requests?

elaine_cs: ~78% under 600 tokens (KB/FAQ), ~12% between 600-2k, rest long analytic. Cost spike mostly from increased tokens per response.

hiro_ml: Low-risk playbook: 1) token-aware routing to a compact-int8 for <=600 tokens; 2) enable KV prefix caching for repeated system prompts; 3) async batch for long analytics.

mike_eng: For quick rollout we can add a routing rule and run a 5% canary. Sample rule to drop into the Console ops playbook: 
```json
{
  "route": "account:ridgeview",
  "rules": [
    {"if": "prompt_tokens <= 600", "model": "rw-compact-v2-int8"},
    {"if": "prompt_tokens > 600 and intent == \"analytics\"", "model": "rw-large-v2-quant", "mode": "async"},
    {"else": "rw-large-v2"}
  ],
  "fallback": "rw-large-v2"
}
```
(We tag async responses with request_id to reconcile later).

elaine_cs: Customer emphasizes KB fidelity — can we ensure no QA regressions?

hiro_ml: We'll run a focused eval on their KB prompts (n=120) including entity recall and exact-match checks. If compact-int8 fails thresholds we'll keep routed slice on rw-medium-v1.

mike_eng: I'll schedule a canary at 5% traffic for 2 hours during low traffic window and collect p50/p95/p99, token delta, and quality alerts. Will add a circuit-breaker to route back to rw-large-v2 when regen-error-rate > 0.7%.

srebot: srebot: Existing rule detected for account:ridgeview: {"route":"account:ridgeview","rules":[{"if":"prompt_tokens<=600","model":"rw-medium-v1"}],"fallback":"rw-large-v2"} 

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary created canary-7265432101 at 7265432120 for route account:ridgeview (pct=5) :rocket:

hiro_ml: Expected wins: compact-int8 reduces unit cost ~30-45% for routed slice, p99 improvement ~15-25ms. Full-account effect depends on long-tail traffic.

elaine_cs: Action items: 1) Hiro run KB eval and share pass/fail threshold (ETA 18h). 2) Mike run 5% canary and post metrics (ETA after 2h canary). 3) Elaine to update renewal doc and coordinate AE with customer for approval.

mike_eng: Noted. I'll also add batch_size=8 tweak on their dedicated pool for the canary window to reduce latency spikes.

elaine_cs: Thanks team — will capture customer feedback after canary and prepare the slide for renewal meeting. :thumbsup:
